plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to meet concentration limits and reduce income exposure.
Trim SPY to 15% to reduce broad index exposure.
Sell QQQ, SMH, METU, SNOW, SMCI to exit downtrending positions.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to zero for capital preservation.
Trim CRWD to 5% to take some profit and reduce concentration.
This plan aims for capital preservation and a large cash buffer.
conservative.read: This conservative approach targets a potential ~1.5% monthly return, prioritizing capital preservation. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also limited upside potential. The focus is on de-risking the portfolio significantly.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to meet concentration limits.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index exposure.
Sell QQQ, SMH, METU, SNOW, SMCI to exit downtrending positions.
Trim SOXL to 3% and sell other leveraged ETFs (SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to reduce overall leverage.
Trim CRWD to 5% to take some profit and reduce concentration.
This plan balances risk and growth with a moderate cash buffer.
balanced.read: This balanced approach targets a potential ~2.5% monthly return, focusing on risk-first growth. It aims for a blend of broad index, quality tech, and limited leverage. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with reasonable growth potential.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% and SPY to 15% to meet concentration limits and free capital.
Sell QQQ, SMH, SNOW, SMCI to exit all downtrending positions.
Add to CRWD (10%) and METU (6%) to press working AI software positions.
Add to SOXL (6%) to increase leveraged semiconductor exposure.
Sell other leveraged ETFs (SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to consolidate leverage.
This plan uses leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive approach targets a potential ~4% monthly return, aiming for stretched growth. It involves higher leverage and concentration, which amplifies both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware of significant daily decay/rebalancing in leveraged ETFs and the potential for rapid losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Add to QQQI (30%) to increase income exposure for monthly distributions.
Trim SPY to 10% to reduce broad index exposure.
Sell QQQ, SMH, METU, SNOW, SMCI to exit downtrending and high-beta positions.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to near zero.
Trim CRWD to 5% to reduce high-beta single name exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady income and low drawdown.
income.read: This income approach targets a potential ~1% monthly return, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth. Remember that distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
